text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I finish up training with Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yay, all done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha, I know! I'll cool down like a<n>champ!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who's that over there?
Huff... Puff... J-just twenty more lapsto... go...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Doto! You're doing great out<n>there! Feelin'
all right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-Taiki?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! I'm just training by<n>myself! So you
don't need to... I<n>mean...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't need to worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

Trainer, can I ask ya something? Is it<n>all right if I
cool down later?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I think Doto's overworking herself<n>again! I know
it's nothin' new, but<n>this time I gotta step in...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run over as fast as I can<n>and give her a
big ol' hug! These<n>arms of mine'll get her restin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run over as fast as I can<n>and give her a
big ol' hug! These<n>arms of mine'll get her restin'!
Yes! I just knew you'd say that,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle runs off at top speed and<n>snatches up
Meisho Doto. It looks<n>like the plan to make her take
a break<n>is working.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I suggest we ask some other trainers<n>for advice on
how to make Meisho<n>Doto get some rest.

Oh, I get it! Protecting Doto is<n>something we all gotta
do together—a<n>group mission!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're one smart cookie, Trainer!<n>Okay!
Let's make this mission a big<n>success!

And so, with everyone's help,<n>Meisho Doto finally
gets some rest.<n>Taiki Shuttle seems very satisfied.
